purpose: Compose canonical Federation capability discovery, concurrency control, route failure memory, evidence proof and mission-scoped authorization into one pre-execution arbitration layer.

new_controls.mission_lease: Repository-scoped mission lease bound to current main SHA, lease epoch and exact path scope.
new_controls.prewrite_fence: Every source write must re-read current main and pass a CAS-style fence; moving main cannot be ignored.
new_controls.workstream_overlap_guard: Overlapping open lanes are serialized; non-overlapping drift is fast-reconverged rather than blindly written.
new_controls.route_memory_gate: Known failed routes are ineligible until their explicit retry condition and recovery proof are satisfied.
new_controls.capability_tournament: CFBE-inspired ranking happens only after reality, readiness, authority and failure-memory hard gates.
new_controls.execution_envelope: Completion claims require authorization, execution, target readback, matching target digest and final receipt.
new_controls.near_miss_learning: Prevented stale writes, overlap collisions and known-dead route retries become reusable learning events.
new_controls.mission_snapshot: Every arbitration cycle can emit a deterministic digest of current main, fence, blocked routes, active failures and next action.

GOOGLE_WIF_INVALID_TARGET.retry_condition: A newer provider-native FEDOMEGA-WIF-CLOUD-VERIFIED receipt must prove provider existence/enabled state, repository/branch trust and service-account impersonation before this route is eligible again.
